test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 16 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The curved surface area of a solid cylinder is (2)/(3) of its total surface area. If the solid cylinder has a total surface area of 231 cm², then find the volume of the cylinder (in cm³). (Use π = (22)/(7))
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of **CSA : TSA** = 2 : 3 ⇒ **h : (h + r)** = 2 : 3 ⇒ **h = 2r**.

Total Surface Area (TSA) = 3 units = 231 cm² ⇒ 1 unit = 77 cm².

Area of two bases (2πr²) = TSA − CSA = 3 units − 2 units = 1 unit = 77 cm².

Radius r² = 77 ÷ (2 × 22/7) = 49/4 ⇒ **r = 3.5 cm**.

**Volume** = CSA × (r/2) = (2 × 77) × (3.5 / 2) = 154 × 1.75 = 269.5 cm³.

**∴ The correct answer is 269.5 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total Surface Area (TSA) = 231 cm²

Curved Surface Area (CSA) = (2/3) × TSA

**Formula Used:**

CSA of cylinder = 2πrh

TSA of cylinder = 2πr(r + h)

Volume of cylinder = πr²h

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4bfc0b2dfd653d3f7ed069c50043255bc46d88de14c4830a7db1746c565204d9.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ CSA = (2/3) × 231 = 154 cm²

⇒ TSA = CSA + 2 × Area of base

⇒ 231 = 154 + 2πr²

⇒ 77 = 2 × (22/7) × r²

⇒ r² = (77 × 7) / (2 × 22) = (7 × 7) / 4 = 49 / 4

⇒ r = 7 / 2 = 3.5 cm

⇒ Now, CSA = 2πrh = 154

⇒ 2 × (22/7) × (7/2) × h = 154

⇒ 22 × h = 154

⇒ h = 154 / 22 = 7 cm

⇒ Volume = πr²h

⇒ Volume = (22/7) × (3.5) × (3.5) × 7

⇒ Volume = 22 × 12.25 = 269.5 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 269.5 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Cylinder Properties

For a cylinder with radius r and height h, Volume = πr²h, and the ratio of Volume to CSA is always r/2.

Total Surface Area

TSA includes the curved surface and the area of two circular ends: TSA = 2πrh + 2πr².

Hollow Cylinder

The volume of a hollow cylinder with external radius R and internal radius r is V = πh(R² − r²).</p
